description:
Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 9 (Bat Mitigation Plan) and partial discharge of condition 13 (Contamination Verification Report) of planning permission ref. 924/APP/2022/3603, dated 24-11-2023 (Demolition of no. 48 and no. 60 Ducks Hill Road, garage and wooden storage unit and the erection of three
new buildings comprising of 12 assisted-living units (Class C2), proposed ancillary communal space, including cafe and restaurant, external connecting link building, landscaping and external works).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Please be advised that in relation to the discharge of Condition 13 (Contamination Verification Report) this decision notice pertains to the discharge of the pre-commencement element only (Part (i)(a)). To fully discharge Condition 13 subsequent applications would need to be submitted to discharge Parts (iii) and (iv), and (ii) if required, following completion of the relevant work.
